Definition: to laugh outright (in merriment or scorn); by implication, to sport
BiblicalUsage: tsâchaq describes to laugh outright. It appears 12 times in Scripture, including Genesis 21:6 and Judges 16:25.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe tsâchaq belongs in His Word because the idea it carries belongs there.
